pr_metadata.title: feat: make websocket client wait timeout configurable
pr_metadata.description:
Add client_wait_timeout field to OpenHandsConfig with default 30s
Replace hardcoded 2s timeout in session.py with configurable value  
Add progressive backoff and improved logging for timeout waiting
Support environment variable OPENHANDS_CLIENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT override

This addresses the issue where 2s timeout was too aggressive for websocket
client connections during initialization.

gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The log message at line 415 uses `self.logger.warning` instead of the reviewer-suggested `self.logger.debug`.
gold_comments.rationale: A warning-level log for routine waiting behavior during websocket initialization may be overly alarming; debug is more appropriate for expected operational delays.
